title: feat(gen): advertise the agent entry points with RFC 8288 Link headers
author: patbing

gist.summary: Added RFC 8288 Link headers to successful GET and HEAD responses for exactly `/` and `/docs` on gen.pollinations.ai. Agents arriving at those HTML pages can discover `/openapi.json` (`service-desc`), `/docs/llm.txt` (`service-doc`), `/.well-known/api-catalog` (`api-catalog`), and `/.well-known/ai-catalog.json` (`describedby`) without knowing the paths in advance. The middleware preserves existing Link values and leaves machine endpoints, redirects, and the API catalog's existing self link unchanged.
